perspicacity, why that Lord of the Titans has gone hence in 
fear, 0 Maithili. 
" It is not possible to take the prudent Rama by surprise

brief.summary_1line: Sarama consoles the grieving Sita, revealing Rama has crossed the ocean and assuring her Ravana used deception and will soon be defeated.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sarama stands beside the sorrowful Sita in the lonely grove, gently speaking while Sita sits dust-covered beneath the trees.
From the grove Sita and Sarama hear the thunder of gongs as ranks of armored titans, elephants, and chariots flood the royal roads of Lanka.
Sarama points toward the distant sea as she tells Sita that Rama has crossed the ocean with an immense army of monkeys.
